traits.name: Mageblood
traits.description: +20% power in its element; unlocks mage guild
traits.expression: Your blood sings with arcane power.
traits.story_hook: The Mage's Circle seeks to recruit you or study your bloodline.

traits.name: Dragonblood
traits.description: Slow aging, dragon-fire resistance, draws dragon attention
traits.expression: Scales hint at draconic heritage in your features.
traits.story_hook: Dragons sense your bloodline and seek you out—for alliance or death.

traits.name: Faetouched
traits.description: Sees through glamours, 50% longer life, fae magic
traits.expression: An otherworldly shimmer surrounds you; fae recognize you as kin.
traits.story_hook: You inherit a contract with a fae entity; every generation must negotiate its terms.

traits.name: Noble Blood
traits.expression: Your bearing and speech mark you as nobility.
traits.story_hook: Your titles are inherited with debts and expectations; heirs may claim lands or repudiate claims.

traits.name: Craftmaster's Hands
traits.expression: Your hands move with practiced precision; you craft instinctively.
traits.story_hook: Legendary weapons forged by your ancestors resurface; rivals covet your family's secrets.

traits.name: The Sight
traits.expression: You see flickers of possible futures; some fade, others grow vivid.
traits.story_hook: Prophecies tie you to events across generations; fulfill them or break them.

traits.name: Warrior's Steel
traits.description: +30% melee damage, faster reflexes; atrophies without battle
traits.expression: Combat comes naturally to you; your reflexes are preternatural.
traits.story_hook: Peace weakens you; you must find battles or your talents fade.

traits.name: Marked by Death
traits.description: One extra life; undead and reapers seek you
traits.expression: Death passes you by once, but spirits pursue you relentlessly.
traits.story_hook: Undead and reapers treat you as an anomaly; some seek to 'correct' you, others to befriend you.

traits.name: Outlaw's Cunning
traits.expression: Shadows seem to favor you; you move unseen and unheard.
traits.story_hook: The Thieves' Guild recognizes you; you inherit their protection or their debts.

traits.name: Divine Favor
traits.description: Miracles and deity favor; 50% chance it is a curse instead
traits.expression: The divine touches you; bless or curse, none can tell.
traits.story_hook: Gods and demons compete for your soul; you must choose which to serve.
